data.name: Karnail
data.gender_notes: Karnail is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Karnail is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘karna’ meaning ‘victory’ and ‘ail’ meaning ‘chariot’. This name is associated with victory, power, and strength. In Hindu mythology, Karna was a great warrior and one of the central characters in the epic Mahabharata. The name Karnail carries the meaning “Victory Chariot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Karnail usually hope their child will grow to embody victory chariot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the power of victory and the strength of character.
data.etymology: Karnail belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory Chariot.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karnail total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Karnail is deeply rooted in Indian culture and is associated with valor and bravery. Karna, the namesake, was a legendary warrior and an iconic figure in Hindu mythology, revered for his unwavering devotion to his brother and friend, Duryodhana, despite knowing that Duryodhana was in the wrong. The name Karnail evokes a sense of power and strength, both in its literal meaning and in the context of the heroic character.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Karnail carries a profound spiritual significance. It is believed that the name is blessed with the divine grace of Lord Shiva, who bestowed the invincible armor (Kavacha) and the divine earrings (Tirumala) upon Karna. These symbols represent protection, strength, and the ability to hear the divine voice of the inner self. The name Karnail reminds us of the importance of remaining strong in our duty towards our loved ones, even in the face of adversity, and of constantly striving to listen to the inner voice of wisdom and self-realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Karnail signifies the embodiment of strength and sacrifice. It is believed that those named Karnail possess inner fortitude and are willing to make significant sacrifices for the greater good. This name is derived from the epic Mahabharata, where Karna, the character whose name it is derived from, embodied these qualities.
